items.content:
Welcome to Honeyglow Woods , a brand-new Disney Dreamlight Valley expansion that's inspired by the iconic Hundred Acre Wood . This new land is packed with puzzles , secrets , and tons of magical Golden Honey. As you explore the area, you'll stumble upon Winnie the Pooh , Piglet , and Eeyore , who you'll be tasked to reunite and welcome back to the Valley.

To ensure you don't miss a single Friendship Quest , new Recipe , Crafting Material , Hedgehog Critter , or mini-game, we've got you covered with our comprehensive Honeyglow Woods Expansion Guide below.

Looking for details on a particular Recipe, Quest, or Resource? Click the links below to jump to:

Want to speed up Golden Honey production? See our guide on How to Get More Busy Bees Houses to learn more.

Available immediately at launch, you'll have full access to three brand-new characters, Winnie the Pooh , Piglet , and Eeyore , each featuring their own unique Story and Friendship Quests to complete. To learn more about each new character , including their Quests, click the links below:

Winnie the Pooh makes his grand debut in Dreamlight Valley as part of the Honeyglow Woods expansion. You'll find Pooh in the Drowsybloom Acre , where he'll need your assistance to restore his home, track down some misplaced honey, and reunite him with his missing pals.

Eeyore is encountered in the Gloommeadow biome of Honeyglow Woods. This area is initially blocked by a Corrupted Honey Wall, but you unlock the pathway during the Quest "Interlude: The Misplaced Honey." In the Gloommeadow, you can help Eeyore restore a dried river, face down a monster, repair his House, and more!

During "Interlude 2: The Gloomy Hollow," you clear out the second of the Corrupted Honey Walls, which unlocks the path to Braveheart Grove. There, you can meet Piglet, who has holed himself up in his House! Help Piglet conquer his fears to unlock him as a Villager!

Need help raising Friendship levels? Try your luck at Pooh Sticks, a brand new mini-game. To learn more, see our guide on How to Play and Win at Pooh Sticks .

There are four sub-biomes in Honeyglow Woods, each with a unique Hedgehog critters for you to befriend and unlock as companions . The four Hedgehog variants include the Classic Hedgehog , the Green Hedgehog , the Yellow Hedgehog , and the Orange Hedgehog .

For full details on how to approach Hedgehogs, as well as their favorite foods, see our comprehensive guides below to learn everything you need to know.

There are 12 brand-new recipes that are exclusive to Honeyglow Woods. With recipes that range from one-star classics to intricate five-star meals , we recommend keeping our Honeyglow Woods Recipe Guide handy, as it provides a comprehensive look at all the ingredients needed to make every new recipe.

In addition to new recipes and critters, you'll also find several new ingredients and fish to uncover in Honeyglow Woods. To learn more about obtaining these new items, see our handy guides below for all the details.

There are eight new flowers to collect, two new gem variants to mine, and three new crafting materials to find. To learn more about obtaining these items, as well as using our checklist tool to keep track of them, see our guides below:

items.title: Honeyglow Woods Duties
items.summary: Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion brings with it not just three new Villagers, tasty Meals, and adorable Critters, but plenty of
items.content:
Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion brings with it not just three new Villagers, tasty Meals, and adorable Critters, but plenty of Dreamlight Duties for you to complete. Like the Wishblossom Ranch expansion , Honeyglow Woods does not have its own separate currency, and so Duties will reward Dreamlight.

Honeyglow Woods' Daily Duties generally pull from the same pool of standard Duties seen in Dreamlight Valley, although it adds some new Daily Duties you may encounter:

Below is a list of all the Dreamlight Duties exclusive to the Honeyglow Woods expansion:

Honey Swirls are swirls of purple and yellow corrupted Honey that can be found in all areas of the Honeyglow Woods. More Honey Swirls spawn regularly as you play. To remove them, simply walk up to the Honey Swirl and select the "Remove" prompt when it appears.

Golden Honey is a new Ingredient introduced in the Honeyglow Woods. It is harvested from Busy Bees Houses. You automatically restore the first Busy Bees House during the Quest Chapter 1: All You Need Is Honey , and you can build three more in the other areas of the Woods - see How To Get More Busy Bees Houses to learn more. After you've built all four, you can learn a Crafting Recipe to make even more!

One Golden Honey is produced every 10-15 minutes. Planting Flowers near the Busy Bees House speeds up honey production. Each Busy Bees House can only hold up to six jars of Golden Honey at a time, so make sure to collect it regularly!

These Duties involve catching and selling the Fish found in the Honeyglow Woods . There are four types of Fish you can catch in this area: Bass, Acorn Snail, Sweet Jelly, and Plush Fish . While all four types count towards the "Catch Fish from the Honeyglow Woods" Duty, only Plush Fish count towards "Sell Fish from the Honeyglow Woods," because Bass are not exclusive to this region and Acorn Snails and Sweet Jellies are not counted as Fish-type ingredients.

The Honeyglow Woods expansion adds two new items that can be mined from Rock Spots: Soft Limestone , a Crafting Material, and Honey Agate , a Gem. Both can be found in all four areas of the Honeyglow Woods. These Duties require you to mine these items and sell them at Stalls such as the one in Drowsybloom Acre.

There are three forage items in the Honeyglow Woods. Sweet Chestnuts , which grow on trees, and Truffles , which grow on the ground, can be found in all areas, while Juniper Berries , which grow on bushes, can only be found in the Gloommeadow and Braveheart Grove areas.

The Honeyglow Woods expansion brings three new crops to farm! Their Seeds can be purchased at the Stall in Drowsybloom Acre. The Stall starts out abandoned, but you can restore it by picking up the Shopping List on the ground next to it and then interacting with the Stall.

The three crops found in the Honeyglow Woods consists of two Vegetables, Parsnips and Golden Pattypans , and one Fruit, Pufflebud Pods . Parsnips are a great choice for the Plant, Harvest, and Sell Vegetables Duties, as they are ready to harvest in only 5 Minutes.

Cooking Duties require you to make Meals using specific Ingredients. Note that you do not need to make Meals specific to the Honeyglow Woods - any Meal Recipe will work, as long as it contains the correct ingredients. The following ingredients will count towards these Duties:

The Honeyglow Woods expansion adds one new Critter, the Hedgehog . There are four Hedgehogs to be found, one in each area of the Honeyglow Woods, and each one can be unlocked as a Companion after regularly feeding them their favorite foods. Hedgehogs have two favorite foods : Pufflebud Pods, grown from Seeds purchased at the Stall in Drowsybloom Acre, and Golden Honey, harvested from Busy Bees Houses.

To quickly raise the Friendship Level of your Hedgehog Companions, perform Foraging tasks with them, such as harvesting the Truffles, Sweet Chestnuts, and Juniper Berries that grow around the Honeyglow Woods.

items.title: Pixel Perfect Update Patch Notes

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the Pixel Perfect free update in our latest \ video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In Pixel Perfect, you’ll once again team up with The Forgotten, this time to fix an old arcade machine and bring Ralph, from Disney’s Wreck-It Ralph to your Valley! You’ll also be able to become Best Friends with your Villagers, upgrade your decorating skills with all new features and highly requested improvements, and much more!

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Pixel Perfect free update arrives on July 29, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT OVERVIEW

To kick off the events of Pixel Perfect, you’ll need to unlock The Forgotten and Peter Pan and complete the quest “The Music on the Wall”.

  • Join the Forgotten as you investigate a glitchy arcade machine near the Dream Castle. This glitchy relic will make a few more apparitions before ending up in Vanellope’s home.

    [/*]

  • Search your Valley for pies, root beer, and bricks that you’ll need to repair the arcade and set up a beacon to free Ralph!

    [/*]

  • Once setup in your Valley, help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make some new friends, wreck a little mayhem, then fix it, to unlock awesome rewards!

    [/*]

  • Get ready to power up with the Pop City Star Path! Transform your Valley and put together a show for the stars with new luminous stage pieces and concert attires! Meet a new loveable feline companion, the paw-fect partner for this new Star Path, as well as two new outfits inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney’s Aristocats!

    [/*]

  • This update we’re also bringing back the Summer Sizzle event, from August 5th to August 18th, where you’ll collect marshmallows, share smores with your friends and complete daily quests around the Valley to unlock brand-new rewards – the first ever dock building.

    [/*]

  • Pixel Perfect will also feature a brand-new Parks Floating Festival! Arriving to the Valley from August 19th to September 8th, enter and explore the thematic floating island inspired by the best of Disney Parks to complete weekly puzzles and earn magical rewards.

    [/*]

  • Then from September 16th to September 29th, the Memory Mania event will return with new quests for you to complete alongside Joy from Disney’s Inside Out. Help spot the differences in memories, and you’ll be able to unlock a brand-new companion!

    [/*]

  • A new update means cool new swag! Coming to the Premium Shop is a brand-new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle that’ll give your Valley a splash of color with vibrant new looks for the Plaza, Dream Castle, Daisy’s Boutique, Chez Remy’s, Scrooge’s Store, and Valley Visit Station.

    [/*]

  • Alongside this new bundle arrives an all-new Environmental Effects item to the Premium Shop! The first of this kind is the Meteor Shower Sky - Fill your skies with cosmic showers, perfect for late night star watching or adding an extra radiant touch to your photos!

    [/*]

  • Get into the back-to-school spirit with a new Village Schoolhouse Skin, along with the matching Village Schoolyard Kit. Also coming this update is the charming Scholarly Owl companion and the new ionic Fantasia Broomstick companion.

    [/*]

  • In addition, we're bringing premade Presets to the Premium Shop. Select bundles, including some existing ones, will now arrive with premade Presets, allowing you to decorate your Valley with greater ease!

    [/*]

  • You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as Pink Leopard Tank Top, Dreamlight Varsity Jacket, Artist's Overalls, Enchanted Castle Tuxedo, Crimson Wayfinder Patterned Skirt, and more.

    [/*]

  • Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

    [/*]

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or access to the Premium Shop.

The Pixel Perfect update was originally meant to include a "Clear Biome" feature in Furniture mode. Unfortunately, we discovered a critical bug in this feature last week, and have patched it out of the Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and Epic versions of the Pixel Perfect update. However, the feature will still be present in the Nintendo and Apple versions of the update and using it could impact various quests' progress. We recommend that our Nintendo and Apple players avoid using this feature for the time being. A hotfix will be deployed to patch the incompatible Clear Biome feature out of the Pixel Perfect update on Nintendo and Apple in the coming days. The feature will return in a later update.

FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS

OLAF’S GRAND EXHIBITION

New Exhibition Rooms

  • Finally, Olaf’s Grand Exhibition will be opening two brand new rooms for you to complete, centered on the Sunlit Plateau and the Frosted Heights. Both arriving with their own unique rewards for completion.

    [/*]

FRIENDSHIPS

General Improvements

We’ve revamped and improved how you engage with your Valley pals.

  • You’ll now be able to use Training Manuals to change any villager’s role, at any level.

    • We’re also revisiting crafting recipes to facilitate making Manuals!

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll also be able to select multiple individual items from your inventory to gift at once.

    [/*]

  • Speaking of gifts, you’ll now be able to re-roll each favorite gift, once per day.

    [/*]

New Friendship Perks

We’ve also updated the perks that come with leveling up your Friendships.

  • Level 7 friends will now also be able to assist you in gathering items! You will now be able to pick 1 item related to your friend’s base roles from any unlocked biome, and request that they collect more for you. The following day, you’ll be able to claim your item bundles from your friend.

    • There are no limits to how many friends you can request help from.

      [/*]

    • Friends will remain available in the Valley while they’re out searching for items.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll now also be able to use your Map to Fast Travel to any of your level 10 friends.

    [/*]

Best Friends!

As of Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to be Best Friends with your Valley’s villagers!

  • Once a villager reaches Level 10 Friendship, their Star Icon will be replaced with a Gold Heart progress bar. This progress bar, for all villagers, will reset daily and can only be filled once per day.

    [/*]

  • Once the new Gold Heart progress bar is filled, you’ll be able to hangout with your Best Friend and get limited time perks!

    • You and your Best Friend will have a Best Friend Glow that will last a limited time and will unlock max level roles bonus for ALL roles.

      [/*]

    • Sprinting will now affect your Best Friend Glow duration but not your Stamina.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Best Friends hangouts can only be had once per day, per villager.

    [/*]

DECORATING

New Crafting Recipes

Introducing new Biome-specific crafting recipes!

  • Complete crafter recipes utilizing ingredients from your base game Biomes to create unique furniture sets!

    [/*]

  • In Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to complete a stunning array of new fae-inspired whimsical furniture pieces for your Peaceful Meadow.

    [/*]

Edit Mode Quick Save

  • To help reduce chances of lost decoration progress, you’ll now be able to “Quick Save” your ongoing decoration changes while still in Edit Mode, without having to “Save & Exit”.

    [/*]

Storybook Vale Floating Islands

  • This update will also introduce three brand-new floating islands for owners of the Disney Dreamlight Valley - The Storybook Vale expansion.

    [/*]

  • Each island will be themed after Biomes found within the expansion, such as The Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter.

    [/*]

DREAMSNAPS

General Improvements

  • We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.

    [/*]

  • You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.

    [/*]

MISC

Environmental Effects

Brand new type of decor for your Valley!

  • The Menu UI has been updated to include a “Special” section for Environmental Effects, like the Aurora Borealis and upcoming Meteor Shower Sky.

    [/*]

  • These Environmental Effects can be applied per area (Biome, Sub-Biome, or Floating Island).

    [/*]

TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

  • We’re addressing an issue where some players didn’t receive a Vault Furniture Reward during Week 5 of the Godly Glamor Star Path. You will need to be eligible to receive a Vault Reward chest - please see our Trello tracker for details: LINK

    [/*]

  • We are aware of an issue where some players who were eligible for the Honeyglow Woods Early Adopter Bonus did not receive it. Please see our Trello tracker for details and next steps: LINK

    [/*]

  • Previously fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest “Chapter 2: About Thought, Fog, and Light“ where the shopping list disappeared and the stall can't be unlocked

    [/*]

  • Previously fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest “Chapter 4: A Tail Tale” where Sometimes Eeyore would be missing for Step 27.

  • Fixed an issue where using the Ancient Vacuum to clear the Honey Swirls in Braveheart Grove before reaching the appropriate step in "Chapter 7: A Voice Behind the Door" quest would prevent players from progressing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where flowers were not respawning quickly enough in Honeyglow Woods.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest "Interlude 3: The Shadowy Surprise" where it was too hard to interaction with the crack in the wall.

  • Fixed an issue in the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack quest "Interlude 3: The Shadowy Surprise" where you could get stuck with 0/4 Honeypots collected.

  • Fixed an issue in the “Interlude 2: The Gloomy Hollow” quest where the Secondary Colors Potion may not be received.

items.title: How to Play and Win at Pooh Sticks
items.summary: Pooh Sticks is a cozy mini-game introduced during Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion. Winning in the minigame is a little harder than you might
items.content:
Pooh Sticks is a cozy mini-game introduced during Dreamlight Valley 's Honeyglow Woods expansion . Winning in the minigame is a little harder than you might think. Thankfully, we're here to help, as this guide details everything you need to know about Pooh Sticks, including how to play , tips and tricks for winning , and the rewards you'll receive for completing all related Pooh Sticks duties.

You'll unlock the ability to play Pooh Sticks during the Chapter 4: A Tail Tale main quest, which acts as a short tutorial rundown of the minigame. Once you've completed the quest, games of Pooh Sticks can then be started by interacting with the small wooden sign found on either the Gloommeadow bridge or the Braveheart Grove bridge .

Upon interacting with the sign, you'll enter a short cutscene and be prompted to choose items from three categories: Wood , Vegetables , and Fruits . Each of the items in these categories have their own advantages and disadvantages.

As you might expect, lightweight items, such as Drywood , Carrots , and Bell Peppers will float faster than those that are more dense and heavy like Pumpkins and Driftwood . However, there's another factor you need to consider, as whirlpools will spawn randomly after you have chosen your item.

Lighter items will slow down when entering whirlpools, whereas heavier items will breeze through them. But, since whirlpools spawn randomly, there's no real way to develop consistent strategies for winning, as the randomness suddenly makes Pooh Sticks more of a game of chance.

No matter whether you win or lose, you will earn a small amount of friendship for all characters that took part in the game. Aiming to win will be key as it rewards the most amount of friendship, and there are duty rewards tied to winning and playing a certain number of games.

I'm going to keep things real honest. As much as I'd love to provide a foolproof strategy that will have you winning every game of Pooh Sticks, it's just simply not possible. While there are in fact particular items that are faster or better equip to deal with whirlpools, Pooh Sticks is ultimately just a game of luck due to the random and unavoidable nature of the whirlpools.

With that said, there does seem to be a general community consensus that using certain object types in particular lanes will give you a slight advantage if the whirlpools spawn in your favor. But, this still isn't a guarantee win.

According to some commenters on Reddit , one of the more popular winning strategies has people using Driftwood or Sticks on the outside two lanes , and then fruits or vegetables such as Bell Peppers, Lemons, or Chestnuts in the middle two lanes .

During my tests, I did try this method for quite a number of games and while I did have some early luck, it wasn't long before I went on a losing skid. This leads me believe that maybe I had just gotten lucky early on.

So, what items or strategies have been working well for me so far? Well, I've listed my current strategies below in hopes that they could help you if you're struggling to net a few wins.

I do want to reiterate once more that there is no one strategy that will win every game. However, I can share what items I have personally had success with so far in my 70+ games of Pooh Sticks, as these could potentially help you if you're struggling to win:

Despite these successes, my win streaks have since been short lived. If you do find yourself struggling to win matches, try changing things up occasionally and testing other items. The biggest key though is to remain patient as winning in this mini-game truly feels very luck based.

items.content:
At the end of "Interlude 2: The Gloomy Hollow," you cleared away the second Corrupted Honey Wall and gained access to Braveheart Grove, a new area of Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods . In "Chapter 7: A Voice Behind the Door," you will explore deeper into Braveheart Grove and rescue Piglet from his house, where he as apparently become trapped!

Head into Braveheart Grove. Note that you can currently only access Braveheart Grove through the path in the top right corner of the Gloommeadow. While there is a bridge connecting Drowsybloom Acre to Braveheart Grove, it is currently broken.

Head to the bottom left corner of Braveheart Grove to where Piglet's House is located - it will be marked on your in-game map with a bright pink circle. You hear Piglet's voice coming from the House, but it seems he is trapped!

There are five Honey Swirls blocking the door of Piglet's House. Remove each one by walking up to it and selecting "Remove."

Once the Honey Swirls are gone, interact with Piglet's door by approaching it and selecting "Talk." Piglet is not convinced that you are his old friend grown up, and believes that you might be a monster trying to trick him.

Talk to Winnie the Pooh. (Eeyore will show up as well!) Pooh suggests that you need to make Piglet feel comfortable - specifically, by cooking food with comforting smells that remind him of home.

Using any Cooking Station, such as the one near the door to Piglet's House, make the following dishes:

Once you have made both food items, interact with Piglet's House door again to give him the comfort food. He believes that you are not a monster, and decides to try coming outside!

Piglet is willing to go outside and meet you - but, when he tries to get out, the door is stuck! You will need to make some Door Grease using the following:

Make the Door Grease at any Crafting Station. The one in Braveheart Grove is located about halfway along the southern edge of the biome, near the entrance to the Everoak Tree.

After crafting the Door Grease, interact with Piglet's House door to use it. The Grease works, and Piglet invites you inside!

Enter Piglet's House and talk to him. He explains that he is scared to go outside because it has become so foggy in Braveheart Grove. You agree to take some pictures for him to show that it is not so scary outside!

Using your Camera, take pictures of the following items:

Piglet's Broom is lying on the ground immediately to the right of his House.

items.title: Chapter 5: The Big Red Monster Walkthrough - Disney Dreamlight Valley Guide
items.summary: During "Chapter 4: A Tail Tale," you met Eeyore and helped him recover his tail, which was stuck under the bridge in the Gloommeadow. Now, in
items.content:
During "Chapter 4: A Tail Tale," you met Eeyore and helped him recover his tail, which was stuck under the bridge in the Gloommeadow. Now, in "Chapter 5: The Big Red Monster," the next Quest in Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion , you are tasked with helping Eeyore solve more problems in the biome he calls home!

Talk to Eeyore, who wanders around the Gloommeadow because he does not yet have a House, although he tends to stick near the river or the wooden gazebo on the left side of the biome.

Eeyore notes that, although you restored the river's flow during the last Quest , there are still lots of dried flowers in the biome. However, he says that watering them isn't safe - because a scary "Big Red Monster" lives somewhere near the Everoak Tree, and never sleeps!

You suggest to Eeyore that you can be brave knights who slay the monster, just like in Christopher Robin's stories!

Gather the following materials to craft the Storybook Sword and Heroic Helmet:

Once you have found the necessary ingredients, craft the Storybook Sword and Heroic Helmet at any Crafting Station, such as the one next to your House in Drowsybloom Acre or the one on the right edge of the Gloommeadow.

After crafting both items, use the Wardrobe Menu to put them both on . (The Storybook Sword is found under the "Back" sub-menu, as it is strapped to the back of your outfit).

Talk to Eeyore while wearing both the Sword and Helmet. He will likely be near the north end of the Gloommeadow, near where you first found him. Eeyore is scared, but he reluctantly agrees to show you where the Big Red Monster is located.

Follow Eeyore to the wall of fog halfway along the right edge of the Gloommeadow (next to the wooden bridge where you play Pooh Sticks ). When you talk to Eeyore, the fog scares him and he refuses to go any further.

Interact with the sparkling spot in the fog to find Fog Dust, which you should then show to Eeyore.

He tells you that you will need to make a Fog-Busting Potion to be able to light the lantern, and that it will have different ingredients than the Honeyglow Elixir you made during "Chapter 2: About Thought, Fog, and Light."

Combine the five ingredients into a Fog-Busting Potion at any Cooking Station in the Honeyglow Woods. (There is one to the left of the Everoak Tree entrance in Drowsybloom Acre and one in the top right corner of the Gloommeadow.)

Show the potion to Pooh and Eeyore - or rather, Sir Eeyore and Prince Pooh - who will both be waiting at the edge of the fog. Use the Fog-Busting Potion in your Inventory to upgrade your Royal Watering Can. Then, use your Watering Can to water the honeycomb lantern at the edge of the fog.

Just like it did in Drowsybloom Acre, the fog will clear! It will reveal a narrow path into a section of the Gloommeadow that you could not access before. Follow the path, clearing out the Honey Swirls as you do.

items.content:
Winnie the Pooh is the first character you will meet in Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion . You can encounter him in the Drowsybloom Acre biome as soon as you travel from the Valley into the Honeyglow Woods. However, he does not immediately unlock as a Villager - you have to complete several Quests before he will officially do so.

This guide covers all Quests you need to complete to unlock Winnie the Pooh in Disney Dreamlight Valley!

In this brief Prologue quest, you need to open your mailbox to find a Treasure Chest inside. In the box is a Tree Sprout that, when placed anywhere in your Valley, will turn into a tree portal. Head through the portal to enter the Honeyglow Woods!

Meet Winnie the Pooh in the Honeyglow Woods in this Quest. Play a game of Hide and Seek together, then help him restore the Busy Bees' House so they can once again begin producing their delicious Golden Honey, which is used to produce all of Pooh's favorite snacks.

Crafta Honeyglow Elixir so that you can clear the fog around Drowsybloom Acre to reunite Pooh with his Thoughtful Spot. Then, gather lots of materials in Drowsybloom Acre to restore the Thoughtful Spot to its former glory!

Splash through some puddles with Pooh on a rainy day in the Honeyglow Woods! Then, help him restore his House so that he has somewhere comfortable to live.

At the end of "A Very Satisfied Bear," Pooh will join the Valley as a Villager. You can raise his Friendship Level by Hanging Out with him, having Daily Discussions, and giving him his favorite Gifts - which, predictably, tend to be recipes that involve Golden Honey! Once he's unlocked, you can get started on Winnie the Pooh's quests .

You've helped Winnie the Pooh explore grown-up activities in "Grown-Up Things," remember what he forgot in "The Backwards Day," and even tried out jobs with him in "Pooh's Grown-Up Job." Now, in his Level 10 Friendship Quest, "The Honey Disaster," you've got to help your favorite bear solve a honey-related crisis in Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods !

In addition to unlocking Pooh , raising his Friendship Level, and completing his three previous Friendship Quests, you also need to unlock the following Villagers before you can begin this Quest:

After you have completed all of the requirements listed above, start the Quest by talking to Pooh, who can usually be found either near his House or in his Thoughtful Spot, both in the Drowsybloom Acre biome.

Pooh says that he attempted to give honey to WALL-E, but, because WALL-E cannot eat, he simply got sticky. Talk to WALL-E, who will be somewhere in the Honeyglow Woods.

It turns out that Pooh accidentally gave extra-sticky honey in leaky honeypots as gifts to his friends. The honey has spilled all over Drowsybloom Acre, so it's up to you to clean it up!

You can find the Honey Spill on the right side of Drowsybloom Acre, between the two large honey trees. Use your Royal Watering Can to clean it up, and pick up the following items that drop:

Show the feather to Pooh, who tells you that one of the people he gave a leaky honeypot to was Scrooge McDuck, so head inside Scrooge's Store.

The version of Scrooge's Store in the Honeyglow Woods is a Blueprint that you must repair. If you have not done so, you can visit the Scrooge's Store location in the Valley and it WILL work for this Quest!

Learn more about Kate and their Dreamlight Valley experience here

Inside Scrooge's Store, you will once again need to water the Honey Spills. There are two spills to the left of the right-most display on the lower floor of Scrooge's Store, and one spill to the right of the same display. They will drop the following items:

Give Scrooge McDuck his feather back. He accepts Pooh's apology for the honey spill, and tells you that the teapot you found belongs to Piglet.

Head inside Piglet's House, which is located in the bottom left corner of Braveheart Grove, near the bridge connecting with Drowsybloom Acre. There are three Honey Spills that need watered - one at the foot of Piglet's Bed and one on either side of the wooden dresser.

When you water them, they drop the following items:

Talk to Piglet, and give him his teapot back. He identifies the fabric as belonging to Daisy Duck, meaning that she probably also got caught up in the sticky mess!

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers,

A brand-new cozy chapter begins today in Disney Dreamlight Valley as you step through a magical gateway into the Honeyglow Woods, a forgotten land where childhood memories, beloved friends, and the gentle magic of honey lingers just beyond the fog.

A Mysterious Invitation

Your journey begins with a mysterious package left in your mailbox, containing treasured childhood keepsakes and a curious little Tree Sprout. Once planted, the Tree Sprout grows into a magical gateway to the Honeyglow Woods itself.

But something isn't quite right.

A strange fog has settled across the Woods, and its once carefree residents have become separated from one another. To start setting things right, you'll meet Winnie the Pooh and work alongside him to uncover clues, clear the fog, and restore the warmth that once filled the Woods.

New Places & Beloved Friends

As you journey deeper into the Honeyglow Woods, you'll discover enchanting new places inspired by the world of Winnie the Pooh, each filled with its own atmosphere, secrets, and stories to uncover.

Wander through the flower-filled meadows of Drowsybloom Acre, splash through misty marshes in the Gloommeadow or brave the deeper woods hidden beyond the fog to eventually uncover the hidden Nectar Apiary, where the source of the Woods' troubles quietly waits.

Along the way, you'll share heartfelt moments with Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, and Piglet. Play games of hide-and-seek with Pooh, help Eeyore search for his missing tail, and encourage Piglet to find courage in the face of fear, all while restoring the warmth that once filled this magical place.

 

Cozy Adventures Beneath the Trees

Beyond the mist, the Honeyglow Woods are full of gentle surprises and cozy discoveries. Care for adorable hedgehogs, restore Busy Bees' Houses to unlock beekeeping adventures, and gather Golden Honey to craft recipes, furniture, and decorations inspired by the golden glow of the Woods.

Take part in playful moments like cloud-watching, rainy puddle-jumping, and Pooh Sticks along the riverbanks, where even the simplest activities become part of a shared adventure with your friends.

The Adventure Begins Today

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is available now as a standalone adventure pack or as part of the Honeyglow Woods Edition for new players looking to begin their journey.

Players who play Honeyglow Woods before July 22nd will also receive the exclusive Rainy Day Winnie the Pooh Dream Style delivered directly to their in-game mailbox.

We can't wait for you to step through the magical glowing tree, rediscover beloved friends, and uncover the adventure waiting within the Honeyglow Woods!

Hey Valley Villagers!

This week, we celebrate 100 years of Winnie the Pooh with our new adventure pack Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods. We invite you to cross through a magical new gateway into a magnificent place, inspired by the Hundred Acre Wood, made up of four unique sub-biomes filled with mystery and magical honey!

Honeyglow Woods is the first ever Disney Dreamlight Valley adventure pack – a new optional paid add-on to be experienced alongside our usual free content updates. This is a new type of experience that allows us to create a unique adventure with thematic landscapes to decorate, a brand-new story, and a cast of loveable characters for those who wish to bring a little extra Disney magic to their Village. For more on this new type of experience, check out our adventure pack FAQ:

https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/faq_adventurepacks

Honeyglow Woods arrives on July 8th, 2026. Check out the details below.

items.title: Catch Up on the Disney Dreamlight Valley 2026 Summer Showcase Stream!
items.summary: Hey, Valley Villagers! Today, we had the absolute pleasure of announcing a totally unique adventure with the Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack, arriving on July 8, 2026! We then pulled back the curtains and peeked at
items.content:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Today, we had the absolute pleasure of announcing a totally unique adventure with the Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack, arriving on July 8, 2026! We then pulled back the curtains and peeked at some of the upcoming free updates you can expect in the back half of the year.

If you missed the Summer Showcase stream, the best way to catch up is by watching it right here:

Welcome to the Honeyglow Woods

Celebrate 100 years of Winnie the Pooh on July 8 with our brand-new adventure Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods!Cross through a magical new gateway into the titular Honeyglow Woods, a land inspired by Winnie the Pooh, filled with puzzles, lost secrets, and a fair share of honey. 🍯

The Honeyglow Woods were once a place where you could enjoy just doing nothing... at least until the Everoak Tree at the center of the Woods closed up.

To embark on this new adventure, you'll need to plant a Tree Sprout until it grows into a magical glowing tree that you'll be able to place anywhere in your Valley, your Floating Islands, or your Expansions—you'll also be able to remove and/or replace this magical gateway at any time. Once you've crossed over to the other side, you'll notice something has gone very wrong in this place... But don't worry, you won't be alone on the journey!

The Friends You Make Along the Way

Soon you'll reunite with Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, and Eeyore to return to the fun, carefree days of childhood!

First, you'll meet the Pooh Bear himself: Winnie the Pooh! Spend some time playing hide-and-seek and watching the clouds go by, then uncover the magic of honey—magical honey that is! Oh, and well, it looks like Eeyore has lost his tail again. Help this delightfully gloomy donkey find a new tail until you can find the real one. Lastly, help the courageous Piglet face his fears, and reunite the trio!

Before you know it, you'll be able to invite Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, and Piglet back to your Valley! They'll of course arrive with their own homes, Friendship Quests and rewards... but first you'll want to solve the mystery of the Honeyglow Woods.

A New Magical Land, with Magical Honey

This magical place, inspired by the Hundred Acre Wood, was where you would spend splendid lazy summers as a kid. It represents a new space to decorate and make your own with four special new areas to discover and progress through.

First is the Drowsybloom Acre, a sunny meadow perfect for napping and smelling flowers. Then there's the Gloommeadow, a murky marsh full of ponds, puddles, and rivers. There's also Braveheart Grove, a dense forested area where you (and Piglet) will face your fears. Finally, there's the Nectar Apiary, a hidden glen filled with honeycombs where you'll find the source of the troubles!

To get to the Honeyglow Woods, you'll use the previously mentioned magical glowing tree. You'll also have special new portals in the Honeyglow Woods that will take you right to Scrooge McDuck's Store and Chez Remy's restaurant.

Speaking of food, in the Honeyglow Woods, you'll be able to use the honey from the bee boxes to unlock new honey-based recipes and furniture, like Warm Milk & Honey, Honeycrunch Bar, Pooh's Birthday Cake, Honeypot Lamp, Cozy Honeyleaf Rug, and so much more!

But wait, that's not the only way you'll be able to use honey! This Adventure Pack also contains a brand-new gameplay mechanic: beekeeping! By placing flowers around a Busy Bees' House, they'll get pollinated, which will generate more honey in the houses. In addition to this, a fully pollinated Busy Bees' House will double the growth of flowers in the same Biome up to their spawn limit. You'll also be able to move these Busy Bees' Houses to any of your other Biomes, including your base game Valley! 

And of course, no new lands in Disney Dreamlight Valley would be complete without a new kind of critter... behold the absolutely adorable hedgehogs! These little cuties will come with their own Photo Mode poses and Friendship Levels to unlock!

The Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack also introduces a new mini-game: Pooh Sticks! By interacting with a Honeyglow bridge in the Gloommeadow, you'll be able to aim and drop a stick (and other items) to race them down the river. This is a new and unique way to interact and level up your Friendship Level with your Villagers and unlock exclusive rewards!

The Adventure Pack and Early Adopter Bonus

The Honeyglow Woods is the first ever Disney Dreamlight Valley Adventure Pack—an optional, paid new add-on to be experienced alongside our usual free content updates. Diving into this sort of adventure allows us to create a unique experience inspired by one beloved universe with thematic landscapes to decorate, a brand-new story, and a cast of lovable Characters for those who wish to bring a little extra Disney magic to their Village. For more on this new type of experience, check out our Adventure Pack FAQ: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/faq_adventurepacks

For those of you already playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, you'll be able to enjoy the Honeyglow Woods on all platforms or purchase this new adventure in the Premium Shop. What's more, you'll get 2,000 Moonstones to spend however you please!

If you're brand-new to Disney Dreamlight Valley, you can get the Honeyglow Woods AND the base game with 10,000 Moonstones! (Psst, that's a special currency you can spend on exclusive furniture and clothing in our Premium Shop.) 

For anyone playing either the standalone Adventure Pack or the bundled edition with the base game before July 22, you'll also receive an exclusive Rainy Day Winnie the Pooh Dream Style in your in-game mailbox with your purchase!

Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition owners will have access to the contents of the Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack on day one without the need for an additional purchase.

What's Next?

We're already halfway through the year, but we're just getting started! Later this summer, you'll meet a long-awaited Villager: Ralph, from Disney's Wreck-It Ralph, who will finally be joining Vanellope in the Valley!

Ralph will arrive in the Valley with some help from the Forgotten. Get swept into video game nostalgia as you help Ralph run a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, and more! This update will also include a new Star Path, features, and quality-of-life improvements—we'll have more info coming soon!

Then later in the year, you can expect two more free base game updates, and a new Disney Dreamlight Valley Expansion... But we'll dive into that at a later date. 😉

Community House Style

We're thrilled to announce a new community activation where you can have your say on what kind of House we should be adding to the Valley later this year!

Use the link below to start voting—all rounds are open until June 26!

https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/community-house-voting

Twitch Drops

Last but not least, this Summer Showcase also kicked off a new Twitch Drops activation!

From today, June 17, until June 24,you can watch our partnered creators' Disney Dreamlight Valley streams to unlock an Eeyore Ears Headband!

For participation and partnered creators' details, visit our website:

disneydreamlightvalley.com/twitch-drops

_________________________________________________________

We can't wait for you to experience everything in this new Adventure Pack when Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods launches on July 8, and for you to welcome Ralph to your Valleys in our free content update. Thank you for taking part in this magical journey with us!

See you in the Valley, and the Honeyglow Woods!

Hey Valley Villagers,

Prepare for an epic new adventure with our latest update: A Hero’s Journey, now available on all platforms! 

Step into a brand-new Realm and embark on a series of heroic trials to uncover the mystery behind the restless gods and help guide Hercules from Disney’s Hercules back to your Valley, working alongside his legendary mentor Phil from Disney’s Hercules.

A Realm Worthy of a Hero

To begin your journey, unlock the Hercules Realm and explore Phil’s training island.  The moment you arrive, it’s easy to see that something’s not quite right. Dark Thorns have started to appear, and a mysterious fog has settled over the woods.

With Hercules nowhere to be found after heading deeper into the forest, it’s up to you to follow the trail and discover what’s happened.

Train like a Hero

To make sure you’re strong enough to chase Hercules into the fog, Phil has prepared special training challenges. Take on obstacle courses where you’ll clear Dark Thorns, activate Moonlight Beacons, and collect rewards as you prove your skills.

As you progress, unlock new abilities and divine tools that will help you on your journey. Travel through shadowed forests, across perilous cliffs, and into an ancient temple. Along the way, earn the favor of different gods through troubled terrain, and ultimately solve the mystery of who caused the chaos in the Realm in the first place.  When you’re done, you’ll guide Hercules and Phil back to the Valley.

Godly Glamor Star Path

Channel your inner deity with the Godly Glamor Star Path, where myths meet elegance.

Earn radiant new outfits, divine-inspired furniture, and mythical companions as you progress through your journey. From glowing celestial designs to majestic decor fit for the gods, every reward will bring a touch of Olympus to your Valley.

Also unlock standout rewards such as the Mythical Cloud Glider, Pink Baby Pegasus companion, Hercules’ Divine Glow Dream Style, and the Olympian Cloud Mansion House Style.

A Heroic Update to the Premium Shop

The Premium Shop is getting a heroic refresh with new items inspired by the world of Hercules and the gods.

Step into mythic style with the Gilded Agora Building Kit, featuring the majestic Grecian Villa House Style, and the ability to summon a fierce new ally with the “good-good-good” puppy Cerberus companion. 

You’ll also find the new Cozy Companion Rajah Bundle, featuring Rajah, Jasmine’s loyal companion, bringing unique interactions with Aladdin and Jasmine, Photo Mode poses, an exclusive friendship reward, and even a Tiger Cub companion. 

Additional highlights include a new Dream Style for Ariel, Moana’s parade float, and new mount accessories arriving in the Shop.

New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

We’re introducing Decoration Presets, a brand-new way to decorate your Valley with ease.

This feature works alongside Group Mode and allows you to select a section of your Valley and save it as a Preset. You can then remove, copy, and replace fully decorated areas whenever you like.

If you don’t own enough of an item in a saved Preset, a Mirage placeholder will appear, letting you quickly craft or purchase what’s missing and place it instantly.

\

Olaf’s Grand Exhibition Expands

Olaf’s Grand Exhibition is growing with two new rooms arriving in this update: the Forest of Valor and the Glade of Trust.

Continue building your collection and celebrate your Valley journey by showcasing even more of your favorite memories and achievements.

Valley Events

There are two exciting events arriving with the A Hero’s Journey Update for you to enjoy in the Valley:

Dreamlight Parks Fest (June 10 – June 30)

Celebrate the return of the Dreamlight Parks Fest! Collect buttons throughout your Valley to earn returning favorites as well as brand-new rewards.

Picture Pursuit Event (July 15 – July 28)

Embark on a new photographic adventure. Complete daily quests, find mysterious motifs, and capture them in photos to unlock exclusive rewards, including a new Photo Mode frame!

We can’t wait for you to explore all the heroic adventures A Hero’s Journey has to offer! Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures by tagging us in your content.

If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via our contact form. Stumped by a certain quest or objective? Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the A Hero’s Journey free update in our latest Developer Update video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In A Hero’s Journey, you’ll travel to a new realm and meet the valiant hero, Hercules from Disney’s Hercules, along with his legendary mentor, Phil! You’ll also be able to level up your experience with some highly requested improvements and an exciting new feature!

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s A Hero’s Journey free update arrives on June 3, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT

To kick off the events of A Hero’s Journey, you will just need to have the Dream Castle unlocked!

  • Step through a new realm door to arrive on a training island owned by the wise satyr, Phil! But wait, this once illuminated island is severely dimmed... Could this be the Realmweaver's handywork? Train and prove you’re fit to be a hero and help illuminate the island once again!  

    [/*]

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

Can you feel that fresh breeze? The Floating Festival is returning with a new blooming edition!

From April 29th, 2026, to May 19th, 2026, venture across a blossoming Floating Island to solve puzzles and claim exclusive seasonal rewards!

What's a Floating Festival?

A Floating Festival is an event that takes place on a specially constructed Floating Island, exclusive to the event period. This island is accessible via a portal located in the Plaza or through the event tab by clicking on the “Teleport” button.

How to Participate

A fresh celebration is in the air, and a curious portal has appeared again in the Plaza. Investigate it to be transported to a new magical place… the Spring Floating Island!

This blooming island invites you to solve its delightful mysteries. Explore each corner and sharpen your mind to tackle its puzzles!

Joining the Festival

  • Find the portal in the Plaza or click “Teleport”.

    [/*]

  • Log in regularly for new puzzles and rewards.

    [/*]

  • Some puzzles require items from your Valley – follow the clues to find them.

    [/*]

Festival Calendar Unlock Schedule

  • April 29th: Rotating Statues, Bamboo Fountain, Capybara Critter Puzzles

    [/*]

  • May 3rd: Labyrinth Puzzle

    [/*]

  • May 7th: Spring Island Quiz Puzzle 

    [/*]

  • May 11th: Escape Maze Puzzle

    [/*]

Puzzle 1: Rotating Statues Puzzle

Locate a curious quartet of statues: a seated lion, a perched raven, and a couple of graceful dancers. These elegant statues are frozen in time and spun out of place and could use a twist, or two. Find a riddle that’ll point you (and them) in the right direction!

  • Complete the puzzle to be rewarded with a majestic Horse Topiary perfect for the spring season!

    [/*]

Puzzle 2: Bamboo Fountain Puzzle

Amidst the blossoming greens, you’ll come across a broken bamboo fountain. Search the surrounding area to locate the hint for what you’ll need and set off to find the ingredients required to fix this fractured fountain.

  • You fix it, you keep it! Repair and claim your new sturdy Spring Bamboo Fountain!

    [/*]

Puzzle 3: Capybara Critter Puzzle

A picky Tinker Bell Capybara can be found wandering about the island looking for something to eat. But before feeding it, you should know this picky capy has very specific wants, and they change day-to-day. Look for a nearby hint, to help you figure out what it wants, and when it wants it! Successfully feed the capybara its favorite food to collect a memory orb!

  • Collect enough memory orbs to uncover a reward dig site. Get out your trusty shovel and collect a snazzy Embroidered Spring Apron!

    [/*]

Completed the first three puzzles? Don’t stop now – three more challenges will start on May 3rd, 7th and 11th! 

Puzzle 4: Labyrinth Puzzle

All work and no play would make anyone feel a little dull. Thankfully, here’s a twisty and twirly maze, with a reward in it! Need a hint? Try asking the Flower... 

  • The Labyrinth Puzzle will be available to enter starting May 3rd, 00:00 local time.

    [/*]

  • Find your way to a prize and claim a wonderful Frog Plushie item!

    [/*]

Puzzle 5: Spring Island Quiz Puzzle

For this puzzle, you’ll want to thoroughly explore and get acquainted with the Floating Island, as you’ll need to answer some very prickly questions... Find the Curious Flower it’s got some questions for ya!

  • The Spring Island Quiz Puzzle will be available to enter starting May 7th, 00:00 local time.

    [/*]

  • Answer all the questions correctly and receive this lovely Pixie Hollow Garden Gnome.

    [/*]

Puzzle 6: Escape Maze Puzzle

The maze hath returned! This time, the beginning is the end... is the beginning? 👈👉 Be sure to check back with the Flower before you run in (out?), you may want to check your corners...

  • The Escape Maze Puzzle will be available to enter starting May 11th, 00:00 local time.

    [/*]

  • Find your way to the end of this maze and collect the whimsy and wacky Wonderland Bird-Brella item!

    [/*]

Additional Information

See below for specifics about the Spring Floating Island:

  • Enjoy the festive decorations... with your eyes only! The island can’t be redecorated in edit mode. Additionally, some of your Royal Tools might not be available on the island, but you’ll still be able to interact with puzzle-related obstacles and some decorative elements.

    [/*]

  • Snap cheerful selfies and capture magical souvenirs! Just remember, DreamSnaps can’t be submitted while on the festival grounds.

    [/*]

  • Make the most of your time in the snowy fields! The Spring Floating Island will only be available during the event period. 

    [/*]

  • Ready to head home? Use the wishing well to exit the Floating Island or open your map for a quick return to your Valley.

    [/*]

You’re now all set to attend the festival! See you on the Spring Floating Island for some blossoming fun!

items.content:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Prepare for a magical adventure with the Whispers of the Wind update, now available on all platforms!

Step into the breathtaking beauty of nature as you welcome Pocahontas from Disney's Pocahontas to the Valley. Follow the whispers of the wind, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a heartwarming journey that leads you to Pocahontas's loyal companion, Meeko.

A Journey in the Heart of Nature

To begin your journey with Pocahontas, you will first need to have Moana as a Villager and have unlocked both the Dazzle Beach and Forest of Valor Biomes.

A gentle, mysterious wind will guide your way. Join Moana and follow the mysterious swirling leaves as they lead you toward a soft glow across the ocean, where something magical awaits. Together, you'll uncover Memories on a mysterious island tied to a rare natural event that once lit up the Valley, and meet a new friend along the way.

Bringing the Celebration to Life 

Help Pocahontas prepare a Celestial Celebration, a Valley festival honoring the Moontide Glow, a magical phenomenon that lights up the waters of Dazzle Beach.

From preparing food and crafting decorations to helping set the scene for the festival, everyone in the Valley has a role to play. Along the way, you'll deepen your bond with Pocahontas, unlock beautiful nature-inspired rewards and eventually welcome Meeko as a new companion.

A Grand Exhibition Opens

A brand-new feature coming in this update displays the magic of your Valley adventures!

Step into Olaf's Grand Exhibition, a special hub where you can showcase your collections and celebrate your achievements. At launch, you'll be able to explore rooms dedicated to the Peaceful Meadow and Dazzle Beach. Share flowers in Dioramas, fish in Aquariums, and companions in Habitats. 

Completing displays unlocks decorations you can place anywhere in your Valley, with more rooms coming in future updates.

Elements of Nature Star Path

Bring the beauty of nature into your Valley with the Elements of Nature Star Path! Collect charming furniture, whimsical nature-inspired outfits, and befriend the cute Hermit Garden Turtle.

This update also introduces Vault rewards, a new way to earn select items from past Star Paths by completing Routine Duties. Keep an eye out, as some Vault rewards will appear gradually throughout the update, and there might be a few surprises waiting for you! Read more about this new feature in our Q&A blog.

New in the Premium Shop

Add a special touch to your Valley with the new Colors of Nature Collection. Decorate Goofy's Stall and the Wishing Well, style your space with the Natural Pergola Set, and enjoy two playful swirling wind leaf effects. You can also meet a delightful new companion, Percy from Disney's Pocahontas.

Crafting Improvements

Finding what you need is easier than ever! The Crafting menu and Uncrafting Station now include handy search bars, smarter filters, and a cleaner layout to help you navigate your items quickly.

Valley Events

There are also two exciting events to enjoy during the Whispers of the Wind update. From April 29 to May 19, the Springtime Floating Festival invites you to explore festive puzzles across the Valley and earn seasonal rewards. Be sure to check out the portal in your Plaza during those days so you don't miss out!

Then, from May 27 to June 9, dig up Treasure Cracks, follow clues, and uncover hidden rewards. You can also try fishing for extra treasures in the Treasure Hunt event.

We can't wait for you to explore all the magic the Whispers of the Wind Update has to offer! Don't forget to connect with us on our official social media channels to share your in-game adventures by tagging us in your content. 

  • Instagram: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram

    [/*]

  • YouTube: https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube 

    [/*]

  • TikTok: https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok 

    [/*]

As always, should you run into any issues while playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, we first recommend that you check out our known issues here. If you don't see the issue you're running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via our contact form. Stumped by a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly Discord Community for some Disney Dreamlight Valley tips and tricks!

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re beyond excited to have shared a first look at the Whispers of the Wind free update in our latest Developer Update video! Now, let’s dive into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In Whispers of the Wind, you’ll meet the bold and nurturing Pocahontas from Disney’s Pocahontas, along with her curious companion, Meeko. You’ll also gain access to highly requested quality-of-life improvements, and a massive new feature.

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Whispers of the Wind free update arrives on April 8, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT

To kick off the events of Whispers of the Wind, you will need to have unlocked Moana in your Valley as well as the Forest of Valor, and Dazzle Beach biomes.

  • With the help of another fellow ocean adventurer, you’ll follow swirling leaves to a mysterious island, where you’ll piece together memories to bring Pocahontas to your Valley!

    [/*]

  • Pocahontas will bring her very own Yehakin back to your Valley and help you learn all about the whimsical Moontide Glow phenomenon changing the oceans.

    [/*]

  • After helping her throw a Celestial Celebration, you’ll use the starlight’s glow to craft a special bait and welcome a new companion – Meeko!

    [/*]

  • Blossom your friendship level with Pocahontas through her quests and unlock additional beautiful friendship rewards, such as her signature clothing set.

    [/*]

  • Celebrate your progress in the Valley in Olaf’s Grand Exhibition, a new hub showcasing items across the Valley’s biomes. Read more about this awesome new feature below!

    [/*]

  • Embrace nature-inspired fashion in the new Elements of Nature Star Path! Unlock lush new furniture and befriend the Hermit Garden Turtle companion!

    [/*]

  • This update also introduces Vault Rewards, a new Star Path feature that lets you earn select rewards from previous Star Paths by completing Routine Duties. Read more about this exciting new Star Path feature below!

    [/*]

  • From April 29 to May 19, explore the Spring Floating Festival for new puzzles and rewards.

    [/*]

  • From May 27 to June 9, the Treasure Hunt event returns — follow rippling waters to uncover hidden notes and earn golden rewards.

    [/*]

  • Add a splash of color with the new Colors of Nature Collection, which will contain the Natural Pergola Set as well as new looks for Goofy’s Stall, the Wishing Well, two unique swirling wind leaves effects, and an adorable new companion — Percy from Disney’s Pocahontas! 

    [/*]

  • You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand new items – See details below!

    [/*]

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or access to the Premium Shop.

OLAF’S GRAND EXHIBITION

To access this new feature, you will need to have unlocked Olaf, from Disney’s Frozen.

Welcome to Olaf’s Grand Exhibition! A new place where you can relive your Disney Dreamlight Valley experience and display your grand collection!

  • Upon entering the Grand Exhibition you’ll find yourself in the impeccable lobby, complete with a miniature replica of the Valley. Here, you will find your host, Olaf, and various doors leading to display rooms featuring various exhibitions.

    [/*]

  • Each room will correspond to a specific biome in your base game Valley. At its inauguration, the Grand Exhibition will have two rooms on display: the Peaceful Meadow, and Dazzle Beach. More rooms will be arriving in future updates.

    [/*]

  • Each room will consist of three grand displays: a story Diorama, a tranquil Aquarium, and a lively Habitat. Once unlocked, you’ll be able to add to these displays and unlock them for your own valley!

    [/*]

 Diorama

  • To unlock, you will need to display a collection of biome-specific flowers.

    [/*]

  • You can then complete the Blueprint panels to add biome-specific storyline elements to a Diorama.

    [/*]

Aquarium

  • To unlock, you will need to display a collection of biome-specific gems.

    [/*]

  • You can then fill an Aquarium with biome-specific fish.

    [/*]

Habitat

  • To unlock, you will need to display a collection of biome-specific foods.

    [/*]

  • You can then fill a Habitat with biome-specific companions.

    [/*]

We’re so excited to finally have a place in the Valley where you can display your collections and view your achievements!

IMPROVEMENTS

PERFORMANCE

  • In this update, Disney Dreamlight Valley will see up to an additional 5 fps boost on the Nintendo Switch! This means players with the most decorated Valleys will see up to 20% faster frame rates following optimizations.

    [/*]

STAR PATH

Star Path Vault Rewards

  • These brand-new reward paths will exist on top of the current ones!

    [/*]

  • Rewards found in the Vault will be made up of previous Star Path rewards you might have missed.

    [/*]

  • If you already own a specific reward in the Vault, it will be marked as such and, in its place, you will receive a random Red Chest.

    [/*]

  • Premium Star Path players will have access to additional Vault rewards that are reimagined versions of previous rewards.

    [/*]

  • Vault rewards are unlocked linearly and only require the completion of Routine Duties.

    [/*]

  • For every three Routine Duties completed, you will unlock one Vault reward.

    [/*]

Star Path Rewards

  • The “Bonus Rewards” sub-menu has been removed.

    [/*]

  • Bonus Rewards are now visible in the general “Rewards” screen. These rewards have been highlighted to be visually distinct from the regular rewards.

    [/*]

  • The “Rewards” screen now also includes a grid toggle, rewards type and DreamSnaps tags for all reward previews.

    [/*]

CRAFTING

Crafting and Uncrafting Station Menus

  • Crafting and Uncrafting Station menus now use the same categories as the furniture menu and the Scrooge Shop Delivery menu.

    [/*]

  • We’ve also added sections for Quest and Event Crafting Recipes.

    [/*]

  • We added search and filters to both these menus.

    [/*]

DECORATING

Group Mode Selector

    [/*]

    [/*]

  • We’ve also improved selection zone visibility over water.

    [/*]

 Fencing and Path Categories

    [/*]

MISC

Scrooge Store

  • Starting this update, you can now expect to see exquisite new clothing items hit the shelves in Scrooge’s Store, like a Blue and White Cottage Dress, a Violet Ombre Strapless Gown, a Violet Ombre Sleeved Gown, a Jewel-Toned Cottage Dress, and more!
